verdict.rationale: Framer's Server API supports automating publishing of live sites and external agents can read/write canvas and CMS content (framer-docs-5, framer-docs-17, framer-docs-18), which covers 'production format' export in the sense of a published website, but there is no documented API or plugin surface for rendering/exporting static screenshots or images programmatically. Missing for 10: explicit image/screenshot export endpoint, documented export formats (PNG/PDF/etc.), and independent confirmation that agents can trigger such renders.
